PFCCL   PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL) was incorporated on March 25, 2008 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC), following PFC's decision to provide its Consultancy Services Group (CSG) an identity of its own in the form of a Company.   PFCCL envisions to be the leading consulting organization in the Country for Power Sector and offers the following services:  1. Advisory Services on issues emanating from implementation of Electricity Act 2003 like Reform, Restructuring, Regulatory etc.  2. Tariff Based Competitive Bidding as per the Guidelines issued by MoP, GoI for various segments of Power Sector  3. Project-Structuring/ Planning/ Development/ Specific Studies, implementation monitoring, efficiency improvement projects  4. Human Resource Management Plans  5. Communication, Information Dissemination and Feedback  6. Preparation of Organization Performance Improvement Plans   7. Contract related services for the Power Sector  7. Financial Management, Resource Mobilization, Accounting Systems etc  b) Rationale for merger;  It is envisaged that the area of operations of PFCCAS (Debt Syndication, Debenture Trustee, Strategy/ Financial Advisory) can complement the area of operations of PFCCL (Reform Advisory, Tariff Bid Process Advisory, Communication Services etc.) providing synergy in the merger of PFCCL and PFCCAS.
